name: Forecast demand per item and location
outcome: A demand forecast at the item and location level.
description: This outcome is the original minus its trailing comparative clause, which said the forecast must beat the naive baseline and the previous method. That clause was already a measure of this job (improvement over baseline) and it is a measurement, not a capability: no vendor markets a forecast as beating a naive baseline, so an outcome requiring that sentence can only be filled by a measured result, and the cell reads empty where the capability plainly exists. Nothing else about the job changed. Evidence is judged by measures, unchanged.
